items.title: Why is my website not showing up on Google?
items.a: The usual causes are pages that aren't indexed (because of a 404, a noindex tag, a wrong canonical, thin content or no internal links), redirect problems, or pages that lost rankings over time. Our Indexing Fix Planner and Site SEO + AEO Audit find the exact cause for each URL.

items.title: What is AEO, and why does it matter?
items.a: AEO (answer engine optimization) means making your pages easy for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews to read, trust and cite. Our AEO checker scores each page from 0 to 100 and lists what to change, such as llms.txt, schema and clear brand facts.

items.title: What do I get from the free site check?
items.a: Send your website and the problem you see. We check it with our tools and reply by email with what is holding it back and how to fix it. There's no obligation.

items.title: Can I run the tools myself?
items.a: Yes. Our actors are public on Apify, where you pay per use, and our skills are on Agensi for AI agents. Every card in the Tools section links to the real listing. Packages and prices are on our pricing page.

items.title: Do you guarantee rankings?
items.a: No one can honestly guarantee rankings. We guarantee clear evidence: a report from a real tool run, a prioritised fix list, and a recheck after the fixes.

items.title: Do you need my passwords?
items.a: Not for the free check or the audits, which use your public pages and any Search Console export you choose to send. A Fix Sprint needs editor access to your site, which you can remove afterwards.

items.title: What is a white-label AI visibility audit?
items.a: It is an SEO + AEO audit of one client site, delivered with your agency's logo and no Cygnix branding. It shows how the site looks to Google and to AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, and lists the fixes in priority order.
